title: Content Pool: STÜRZL Steuerstrafrecht
subtitle: Homepage first. Existing site. Law firm, BRAO mode. Frankfurt and München.

findings.text: The topics are not the gap. The depth is. Almost every service a competitor shows is also on the client's site. But the 15 measured service pages have 142 to 291 words (median 227), each with 2 H1 and no H2. The 13 competitor pages for the same topics have 642 to 5,890 words (median 1,677). The one strong text, the FAQ page (2,555 words), has 6 H1.

The homepage has {bench.own} words. The floor from gate A0 is {bench.floor} words (70 % of the median {bench.median} words of {bench.n} Frankfurt law-firm homepages). Title "Home", H1 "Kanzlei": no service and no city.

Most of the search demand is informational, not hiring intent. "steuerfahndung" 6,600, "steuerhinterziehung strafe" 4,400 and "steuerhinterziehung verjährung" 2,400 searches per month, against "anwalt steuerstrafrecht" 480, "anwalt steuerhinterziehung" 210 and "selbstanzeige anwalt" 10. Core hiring searches such as "steuerfahndung anwalt" have no record in the volume data, but Google autocomplete shows them. Volume "no data" is not zero demand.

The big search volumes next to the services are not on the service list. "anwalt steuerrecht" and "fachanwalt steuerrecht" have 1,600 searches each, "strafverteidiger münchen" 1,600. The title Fachanwältin für Steuerrecht is public but not confirmed, and general criminal defence is not proven. They stay adjacent. Martin decides after the client answers.

Proof is thin on Google and strong on anwalt.de. Frankfurt has 14 Google reviews. DREYENBERG has 83, ROSE & PARTNER 60, El Ouali 55, and the general criminal-law firms 300 and more. The anwalt.de profile shows 79 reviews. Reviews must come without incentives, and anonymity matters to the client.

The client's own visibility is almost only the brand. DataForSEO knows 18 own keywords with volume. The best generic one is "anwalt steuerrecht frankfurt" at position 17. Her Search Console is not available yet (HTTP 403), so own clicks and queries are missing.

Google shows an AI overview on 5 of the 13 readable result pages, among them "anwalt steuerhinterziehung", "selbstanzeige anwalt" and "steuerstrafverfahren ablauf". Short answer blocks under real questions help here. Portals (anwalt.de and others) fill many first pages and are link targets, not competitors.

pillars.location: Two confirmed offices, treated as equals: Frankfurt (Untermainkai 26) and München (Oberanger 32). Hero and title with the field and both cities. One location block on the homepage with both offices, and one own page per office. Suburb pages and a Düsseldorf page fail the proof rule and are cut. Open: final Frankfurt address, one opening time, the München contact details.
pillars.service: Six strong service areas instead of nine thin ones: Steuerstrafrecht, Selbstanzeige, Steuerfahndung und Durchsuchung, Wirtschaftsstrafrecht, Compliance (new), Zoll und Begleitdelikte. Plus cost explanation, a clean FAQ hub and a contact form with a lawful consent text. Tax-law advice and general criminal defence wait for the client.
pillars.brand: Steuer- und Wirtschaftsstrafrecht, Zoll and the related offences from one firm, without "Spezialist" claims. Two groups of clients: private persons and companies. Discretion and reachability as the way of working. Clean up the team page.
pillars.authority: Confirm both titles first. Then press mentions with links, the anwalt.de reviews, lectures and anonymised cases. Reviews only without incentives. Portal listings and the 15 unlinked mentions go to the backlink workflow.

decisions: Titles: Dr. Stürzl must confirm "Fachanwältin für Steuerrecht" and "Zertifizierte Beraterin für Steuerstrafrecht (DAA)". No "Spezialist" wording either way (BRAO).
Redirect proposals (three, in the sitemap): clarify with Irsch (Martin, 2026-10-11).
Adjacent topics CP-SVC-025, 026 and 027 (Betriebsprüfung, general tax advice, general criminal defence): keep them out of the homepage until the client answers.
Compliance (CP-SVC-012) needs the text of Dr. Glogger before copy starts.
Search Console: ask the IT contact to add reporting-bot@studio-apis-503306.iam.gserviceaccount.com. Then re-run the pool with real client queries.
Send the German client form (10 open facts) before copy starts. It is a draft.
